# Behror Solar

> Behror Solar provides residential, commercial and industrial rooftop solar services in Behror, Neemrana and surrounding areas. Founded and led by Mahendra Yadav, Behror Solar works with Global Green Energy (GGE) for installation services. Mahendra is a partner and investor in GGE.

GGE is an Authorised Tata Power Solaroof Channel Partner and registered PM Surya Ghar vendor. Quotations, contracts, invoices and PM Surya Ghar vendor documentation are issued through GGE. Official Tata Power Solaroof installations and custom Premier Energies systems are separate offerings; custom Premier systems contain no Tata products.

Based near Hanuman Mandir, Mohalla Nainsukh, Behror, Rajasthan 301701. Phone: +91 94144 53454. Email: myadav@behrorsolar.in. Service areas include Neemrana, Shahjahanpur, Jat Behror, Mundawar, Khairthal, Harsora, Tatarpur, Harsoli, Bibirani, Ghiloth and Mandhan. Neemrana is approximately 20 km / 20 minutes from the Behror base.

The linked pages provide detailed specifications, evidence and qualifications. Installed-system prices include GST; exact equipment, phase configuration, warranty coverage and costs are confirmed in the project quotation after a site survey. Bulk panel prices are separate: minimum order one pallet, excluding GST and freight, with current stock and freight confirmed on enquiry.

## Installation services and systems

- [Solar installation in Neemrana](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-installation-neemrana): Residential, commercial and industrial installation in Neemrana, Shahjahanpur and nearby areas, with local project photographs.
- [Commercial solar](https://behrorsolar.in/commercial-solar): Rooftop solar assessment and installation for commercial properties, institutions and industrial customers; residential subsidy assumptions do not apply to commercial connections.
- [3 kW solar system](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system): Official Tata installation at ₹2,00,000 or custom Premier TOPCon at ₹1,85,000; compare generation records, roof area and residential subsidy-adjusted costs.
- [5 kW solar system](https://behrorsolar.in/5kw-solar-system): Official Tata installation from ₹3,00,000 or custom Premier TOPCon at ₹2,80,000, for standard single-phase configurations; three-phase is an additional cost confirmed in the quotation.
- [10 kW solar system](https://behrorsolar.in/10kw-solar-system): Official Tata installation at ₹5,50,000 or custom Premier TOPCon at ₹5,20,000, with three-phase inverters; connection type and upgrade requirements are confirmed during assessment.
- [Solar panels — DCR and non-DCR](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-panels-behror-neemrana): Module-specific certificates, wattages and efficiencies, panel comparisons, installed systems and separate bulk supply options.
- [Solar battery and backup](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-battery): LiFePO₄ storage, kWh/kW sizing, backup circuits and retrofit assessment; the existing inverter and system are assessed before recommending a hybrid-inverter upgrade.
- [Hybrid solar](https://behrorsolar.in/hybrid-solar-behror-neemrana): Solar, hybrid inverter and battery configurations designed around daytime consumption and power-cut backup requirements.
- [On-grid vs hybrid vs off-grid](https://behrorsolar.in/on-grid-hybrid-off-grid-solar-behror-neemrana): System-type comparison covering grid dependence, battery backup and local installation considerations.

## Subsidy, warranty and support

- [PM Surya Ghar subsidy guide](https://behrorsolar.in/pm-surya-ghar): Central CFA up to ₹78,000 for eligible residential installations, including systems above 3 kW. The additional ₹17,000 Rajasthan benefit is conditional on eligibility under the solar-linked 150-units-per-month Nishulk Bijli scheme. Existing free-electricity enrollment alone does not confirm payment; state registration, DISCOM eligibility and disbursement require separate checks. Also covers documents, equipment compliance and JVVNL net metering.
- [Tata Power Solaroof warranty guide](https://behrorsolar.in/tata-power-solaroof-warranty): Registration, certificate verification, component-specific coverage and claims. The reviewed on-grid certificate lists 12-year module product, 30-year module output, 8-year inverter and 5-year other-BOS coverage. Custom-system warranties and service arrangements follow their own quotation and applicable terms.

## Generation evidence and independent reviews

- [TOPCon vs Mono PERC field records](https://behrorsolar.in/topcon-vs-mono-perc-field-test): Same-roof September 2026 records show 529.13 kWh from 3.66 kWp TOPCon and 385.4 kWh from 3.18 kWp budget Mono PERC: an observed 19.3% difference per rated DC kWp. Separate inverters and other conditions limit attribution; this is not an annual generation or lifetime savings guarantee.
- [Tata generation — Alwar City](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system#tata-generation-alwar): Six 590 W panels, 3.54 kWp DC, recorded 521.1 kWh over 9 September–8 October 2026.
- [TOPCon generation — Behror](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system#september-generation): Six 610 W panels, 3.66 kWp DC, recorded 529.13 kWh over 1–30 September 2026. Different sites, dates and capacities prevent a matched Tata-versus-TOPCon ranking.
- [TRYDAN TECH battery review](https://behrorsolar.in/trydan-tech-battery): Independent 12.8 V 100 Ah LiFePO₄ observations with a 2017 Luminous inverter, including nine-hour grid-OFF operation and a 43-hour isolated voltage log; not a verified full-capacity test.
- [Solar guides](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-guides): Index of local explainers, equipment guides and dated test records.
